entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This place is oddly calming.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Have you learned anything new?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's sealed by a rotary lock. We'll[n]need the combination to open it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Meooowgh!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: A rotary lock, hm?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I knew it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How did you get that?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I simply memorized the combination.[n]I saw him open and close it so many[n]times, after all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: W-Well that's... scary. But amazin' too!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Urghhh, that burns... Hey, hurry up and[n]open it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-How much is this!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I believe one stack is one million yen...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: One, two, three... Uhhh, there's thirty[n]of them in here!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thirty million yen... Even after splitting it,[n]we still each get five million!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Holy shit... It's gonna be deluxe pork[n]soup combo for me from here on out!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You have to think bigger than that...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Not to bring down the excited mood...[n]but does this money look real to you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Children's Bank!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: F-For real!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I guess this represents... how everything[n]he did was an act to make himself seem[n]tough?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nooooooooo!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well hey, at least it feels like we totes[n]busted this case, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is busting a case good or bad?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Both!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Snrk... *chuckle* Ahahahaha!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: To think the reward for the Phantom[n]Thieves is feeling they "totes busted"[n]the case...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ahhh... How funny!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hold on a second.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Even though the contents were nothing[n]more than trash, the case itself is quite[n]nice.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right then, let's sell it! Glad we got[n]that sorted!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: By the way Morgana, have any of your memories[n]returned?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: No, not at all...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, did that hit to your head make[n]you forget even more?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's easy for you to talk. You're not[n]the one who lost your memories.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You have amnesia?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Something like that. He does remember[n]searching for Treasures though.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm. I hope your memories return soon[n]then.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So... what happens next?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: First, we wait for Kaneshiro to have his[n]change of heart.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It's gonna be big this time. People're[n]gonna make a huge deal out of it,[n]for sure.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, you know what Kaneshiro said[n]at the end there?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: About that "criminal" using[n]the Metaverse...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, I was bothered by that as well.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: No point mullin' over it now. Let's wait[n]and see how Kaneshiro's change of heart[n]goes first.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We should prolly just lay low for a while.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I never thought I'd hear those words[n]coming from you.
